column1: # *** THE SOUTH AFRICAN FULL-TEXT SEAM, WORKED TO THE END. 9 October 2026. ***
# On 8 October this archive published that South Africa was not in the full-text corpus. It was
# wrong - a URL place parameter errors where the in-page facet works - and the correction opened a
# route. Three of the hits were read that day. *** THIS FILE CLOSES THE OTHER SIX. ***
# *** NINE HITS UNDER 'AFRICA', AND EVERY ONE IS NOW ACCOUNTED FOR. *** Two are this family, two are
# a different South African family of the same surname, one is a living person, two are excluded on
# chronology or population, and two were already read.
# *** THE FACET HAS TO BE OPENED IN THE PAGE, AND THEN APPLIED. *** Ticking 'Africa' does nothing on
# its own: the count stays at 44,012 until the Apply button is pressed, and that button's label is
# 'Apply', not 'APPLY' - which cost a round trip here.
*** ROQUE LUIS ARMANDO LERENA, AND HIS ADDRESS AT LAST ***
column2: *** Voter Records: South Africa, Voting Records 1925-1931 ***, image 606, ark 3:1:3QHV-GQVF-S7YR-K - *** A SECOND ROLL OF THE SAME DISTRICT ***, where the one read on 8 October has him as voter 1491. Here he is *** 1399 ***, and the printed line reads in full: '*** 1399  Lerena, Roque Luis Armando  ....  14 Florence Villas  ....  Fireman  ....  O  ....  Sole tenant  ....  —  ....  E ***'. Header: *** POLLING DISTRICT No. 770, FISCAL DIVISION OF THE CAPE - FISKALE AFDELING DIE KAAP ***. *** PLATE READ 9 October 2026 ***.
column3: *** THE OPEN ITEM FROM 8 OCTOBER IS CLOSED. *** That day's note said 'the columns cannot be aligned from the OCR, so his address needs the plate read by eye'. It was read by eye. *** 14 FLORENCE VILLAS ***, and he is the *** SOLE TENANT *** of it - not a lodger and not an owner. Born 6 December 1905, he is about twenty-two here.

column1: *** AND HE IS A FIREMAN, WHICH IS NOT WHAT HIS FATHER WAS ***
column2: The occupation column on his line reads *** Fireman ***. The lines around it read *** Loco. Cleaner, Engine-driver, Signalman, Porter, Checker, Guard, Vandriver, Shunter, Storeman ***.
column3: *** PABLO ARMANDO WAS A HORSE-DEALER IN 1911 AND A TRAINER BY 1940. HIS ELDEST SON WENT TO THE RAILWAY. *** *** THAT 'FIREMAN' MEANS A LOCOMOTIVE FIREMAN IS AN INFERENCE FROM THE COMPANY HE KEEPS ON THE PAGE, NOT FROM THE WORD. *** It is a strong one: this is a roll of railway grades, and the district runs along the *** Salt River *** works. The word alone could mean a fire brigade and the page does not say.

column1: *** AND THE DISTRICT HAS A NAME NOW ***
column2: The roll's own entries: line 1418 gives '*** Louis Botha Hostel ... OBSERVATORY ***' in the locality column - the only line on the page to carry one - and the streets are *** Lower Main Rd, Trill Rd, Scott Rd, Arnold St, Rochester Rd, Nuttall Rd, Station Rd ***, with several addresses written '*** Salt River ***'.
column3: *** POLLING DISTRICT 770 IS OBSERVATORY AND SALT RIVER, CAPE TOWN. *** The archive had the number and not the place. *** THIS IS THE ROLL ITSELF SAYING SO, NOT AN ATLAS: *** one voter's locality column and a page of street names that only sit together in one part of Cape Town.

column1: *** NUNO FERNANDO LERENA HAS A SECOND PROPERTY ***
column2: *** Land Records: South Africa, Farm Records 1895-1955 ***, image 216, ark 3:1:3QHK-N7NW-G375. *** PLATE READ 9 October 2026: *** '*** No. 210 ... Extent ... 14,560 Sq. Feet ... Transferor: T/SHIP OWNERS ... Transferee: NUNO FERNANDO LERENA. 6.10.24 ***', transfer no. 2257(7), *** dated 22.8.53 ***, header '*** LENDIN *** [Street]' - *** SO WRITTEN, AND NOT RESOLVED; AN EARLIER VERSION OF THIS ROW READ IT 'LONDON' AND THAT IS WITHDRAWN. ***
column3: *** A SECOND LOT, BESIDE THE ONE ALREADY HELD *** - lot 245, Cologne Road, 6,600 sq feet. This is lot 210, *** 14,560 sq feet ***, bought from the *** TOWNSHIP OWNERS ***, which is how a new township sells its first stands. *** THE TRANSCRIPT CALLED HIM 'JAN FERNANDO' AND THE OTHER CALLED HIM 'HUNO'; THE PLATE WRITES NUNO BOTH TIMES, PLAINLY. *** *** AND THE DATE AFTER HIS NAME IS NOT THE TRANSFER DATE: *** this folio has a separate 'Transfers - No. and Year - Date' column carrying 22.8.53, so *** 6.10.24 is an identity date *** - his birth date, which the 1950 estate and death notice 6746/71 held before any of this was found.

column1: *** AND THE TOWNSHIP IS STILL NOT PLACED ***
column2: Two streets and no town on the folios themselves: *** COLOGNE ROAD *** (lot 245) and a street written *** LENDIN *** (lot 210)
column3: *** AND THE ANSWER WAS ALREADY IN THIS ARCHIVE, READ ON 16 SEPTEMBER. *** His death notice *** MHG 6746/71 *** gives his residence as '*** 24 LEIDEN ROAD, GERDVIEW, GERMISTON ***' - and *** COLOGNE ROAD IS A STREET IN GERDVIEW, GERMISTON ***, postal code 1401, confirmed outside this archive. *** SO THE TOWNSHIP IS GERDVIEW, GERMISTON, AND THE STREETS ARE NAMED FOR DUTCH AND GERMAN CITIES *** - Leiden, Weert, Cologne. *** THAT SCHEME IS ALSO WHAT CONVICTED THE SECOND READING: *** 'London' did not belong to it, the plate went back under a harder magnification, and it says *** LENDIN ***. *** THE TOWNSHIP IS PLACED ON LOT 245; LOT 210'S STREET IS STILL UNREAD. ***

column1: *** AND A SECOND SOUTH AFRICAN LERENA FAMILY, EXCLUDED FOR THE SECOND TIME ***
column2: *** Land Records: South Africa, Farm Records 1927-1947 ***, image 73, ark 3:1:3QHK-G7F2-6WJT: '*** late LUCAS LERENA ... Spouse RACHEL LERENIA (born MALEKA) ***', *** Eaton Township, lot 570 ***
column3: *** NOT THIS FAMILY, AND THE SECOND RECORD TO SAY SO. *** On 8 October this archive excluded *** SEKO LERENA *** of the Ned. Geref. *** Sending Gemeente Kranspoort *** - a mission congregation - on the same ground. *** MALEKA IS A SOTHO-TSWANA SURNAME AND THE TWO RECORDS ARE A HUNDRED MILES AND FORTY YEARS APART ***, so this is a population carrying the name, not a stray. *** IT IS RECORDED BECAUSE AN EXCLUSION IS EVIDENCE: *** a searcher who meets 'Lerena' in a Transvaal record should know there are two unconnected families of the name in South Africa.

column1: *** AND THREE THAT ARE NOT EVIDENCE, SAID PLAINLY ***
column2: *** Southern Rhodesia Society Records 1890 ***, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CSLF-V9W4-T - a *** Pioneers' Society application at Bulawayo ***, for a minor descendant of a 1895 pioneer surnamed DE JAGER; the subject's surname is transcribed both 'Gerena' and 'LERENa'. *** Fauresmith, Orange Free State, Court Case Files 1855-1871 ***, ark 3:1:3QS7-89HP-8965-P. *** School Admission Application Files 2000-2012, Freetown, Sierra Leone ***, ark 3:1:3QHJ-K72K-325B.
column3: *** THE RHODESIAN ONE IS A LIVING PERSON AND NOTHING FURTHER IS RECORDED *** - no date, no place, under this archive's own rule. She is a De Jager descendant and nothing connects her here. *** FAURESMITH IS EXCLUDED ON CHRONOLOGY: *** the file ends in 1871 and this family reached South Africa after 1900. The 'hit' is the fragment 'Knap Lerena' inside badly garbled bilingual court testimony - *** not a reading this archive would print. *** *** THE FREETOWN FILE WAS NOT OPENED, AND THAT IS A DECISION: *** it is school applications by living children in another country, and there is no evidential purpose that would justify reading them.

column1: *** SO THE SEAM IS WORKED OUT ***
column2: Nine hits under the Africa facet: two this family, two a different family of the name, one living, two excluded, two already read on 8 October
column3: *** THE SOUTH AFRICAN FULL-TEXT CORPUS HAS NOTHING MORE FOR THIS SURNAME. *** *** AND IT NEVER HELD WHAT THIS ARCHIVE MOST WANTS: *** there is no Cape civil registration in it, so *** Careen Maria's parents and Pablo Armando's own father remain out of reach by this route ***, and both still need Home Affairs or the Western Cape Archives. *** WHAT IT DID GIVE WAS TWO SONS' LIVES: *** an address, a trade and a tenure for Roque, and a second property for Nuno.
